parts.name: L4/L5 pressure hatch at the 0 deg ladderway
parts.prov: CLAUDE_DESIGN v0.5.6: floor L4 becomes a pressure bulkhead so a depressurised L5 (airlock, docking tunnel) cannot take the rest of the habitat. Two hinged pressure hatches (rounded-square, ISS CBM-hatch style) close the ladderways; a pressure plug with a lift hatch and feedthroughs seals the trunk at the same plane. Hatches stand open in normal operations and close automatically on a pressure drop

parts.name: Storm shelter 72 h stored life support (O2, LiOH, food, battery)
parts.prov: Consumption: Barta, Anderson and Lange, NASA JSC 2015 (ntrs.nasa.gov 20150009498): O2 0.84, CO2 1.00, drinking water 1.62, food 0.62 kg per person per day. Stored backup on L4 for 72 h if the life-support room's regenerative systems are unavailable; drinking water drawn from the shelter's own water jacket. Battery covers 24 h of essential loads; the plant otherwise powers the shelter
